verdict.rationale: Docs confirm best-in-class PBR materials, WebGL/WebGPU rendering, and clustered lighting, and community feedback consistently calls Babylon's renderer 'more of a game engine' with strong visual fidelity (comm-6, comm-16, comm-9). However the evidence pack lacks explicit confirmation of a shadow-mapping system or a post-processing pipeline (bloom, SSAO, etc.) — missing for 10: explicit shadow system docs, explicit post-processing/effects pipeline docs, and baked-lighting/GI workflow details.
